-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Bronze Magic.png  |title= Bronze Magic |kanji= 青銅魔法 |romaji= Seidō Mahō |english= Bronze Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Sekke Bronzazza }} :For the magic used by Cesc, see Shakudo Magic.  {{Nihongo|Bronze Magic|青銅魔法|Seidō Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate bronze.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate bronze at will. The users are able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are
